text: that my head were waters: Heb. who will give my head etc.
in heart: Heb. in the midst of him | his wait: Or, wait for him
habitations: Or, pastures | burnt up: Or, desolate | both the fowel of the heavens: Heb. from the fowel even to etc.
in the utmost corners: Heb. cut off into corners, or having the corners of their hair polled
